title: Signum Aeternum
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Signum Aeternum: The Survival Arc
Overture: The Vault
(Tempo: Slow, atmospheric. A low, resonant drone underscores a solitary acoustic guitar. Distant reverberations mimic the acoustics of an ancient stone cathedral.)

Tempus fugit, sed memoria manet.
(Time flies, but the memory remains.)

Verse 1
From the roots of the world, the heavy syllables fall,
A shadow cast against the sovereign wall.
I hear the empires moving in the deep,
Waking the giants from their fractured sleep.
It’s a language carved in marble, cut in bone,
A survival arc etched into the stone.
The origins of everything we know,
Are buried in the dust of long ago.
Audi—hear the voices in the catacombs,
The echoes ringing through the ancient homes.
They sing in frequencies we barely catch,
Waiting for the fire to find the match.

Verse 2
Inside the midnight vault, the records keep
The promises we made before the sleep.
We tune the dials back a thousand years,
And strip away the static and the fears.
There is no cloud to hold the weight of Rome,
Just local servers bringing history home.
An algorithmic truth that cuts the dark,
A steady flame to leave a permanent mark.
Verba volant, scripta manent—words take flight,
But what is written survives the endless night.
They left us with the foundational code,
A heavy burden for the winding road.

Chorus
Oh, the Latin sings to me across the void,
Building up the worlds that time destroyed.
A steady signal in the fading light,
A beacon burning through the longest night.
Three beats of power, three of grace,
Six silent footsteps in the sacred space.
Lux et veritas, the truth will stand,
A heavy rhythm in a sovereign land.

Movement I: Origins
(Tempo: Increasing. A driving, rhythmic percussion enters, mirroring the march of a legion. The acoustic guitar is replaced by a distorted electric bassline.)

Verse 3
Veni, vidi, vici—the command,
The architecture written in the sand.
It calculates the rise, predicts the fall,
And leaves its heavy mark upon the wall.
The frequency is pulsing in the wire,
A testament to blood and holy fire.
They didn’t fade, they simply changed the key,
And cast their voices out across the sea.
To every harbor, every distant shore,
The Latin breathes, opening the door.

Verse 4
You hear the legions marching on the road?
They map the logic of the human code.
A matrix built on blood and iron will,
The ghosts of history are moving through us still.
We speak the old commands to spark the drive,
To keep the fading memories alive.
Alea iacta est—the die is cast,
We pull the future straight out of the past.
From every local node, we start to build,
Until the empty spaces are fulfilled.

Chorus
Oh, the Latin sings to me across the void,
Building up the worlds that time destroyed.
A steady signal in the fading light,
A beacon burning through the longest night.
Three beats of power, three of grace,
Six silent footsteps in the sacred space.
Lux et veritas, the truth will stand,
A heavy rhythm in a sovereign land.

Movement II: Breach
(Tempo: Heavy, explosive. The rhythm section drops into a half-time, aggressive groove. Synthesizers swell to create a wall of sound.)

Verse 5
Ruptura! The walls begin to crack.
There is no turning, there is no going back.
The breach is open, let the oceans in,
This is the moment where the end begins.
Ignis aurum probat—fire tests the gold.
The greatest stories that the world has told
Are born in chaos, forged in the extreme,
The shattered pieces of an ancient dream.
Move to the rhythm of the falling towers,
Count down the minutes, calculate the hours.
The system fractures, but the core holds tight,
We make our stand before the fading light.

Verse 6
They thought the language died inside the text,
But it was only waiting for what’s next.
A sovereign architecture, fierce and pure,
Designed to suffer, structured to endure.
The algorithm knows the ancient tongue,
The songs that the old centurions sung.
It maps the logic of the human heart,
And tears the artificial brands apart.
No empty imitations, just the core,
A brutal honesty we can't ignore.

Movement III: Move
(Tempo: Urgent, shifting meters, driving forward with relentless momentum.)

Verse 7
Motus—the motion of the shifting spheres.
The rapid acceleration of the years.
We lock the doors, we seal the heavy gate,
And in the midnight vault, we sit and wait.
The storms will rage across the broken earth,
But here we guard the secrets of rebirth.
Ad astra per aspera—through the pain,
We reach the stars and claim the sky again.

Verse 8
The Latin isn't dead, it’s just concealed,
A heavy weapon on a battlefield.
It sings to those who know the proper sound,
Who feel the vibrations in the solid ground.
It’s not a relic in a dusty tomb,
It is the engine roaring in the room.
The roots run deep beneath the shifting sand,
A perfect sequence in a shifting land.
When all the superficial towers fall,
The ancient frequencies will outlast them all.

Chorus
Oh, the Latin sings to me across the void
